description.intro: The Winterprojekt 2026 will take place in a Create mod modpack.
description.create: Create offers a completely new way to play Minecraft. Everything revolves around rotational energy, which we can use to build machines, automatic crafters, trains and more!
description.rules: This year, there is a fixed set of rules for the first time. I ask all participants to read them before the project starts.

countdown.until: until the project starts on 27.11.2026 at 6:00 PM (CET)

rules.title: Rules
rules.text: This year, there is a fixed set of rules for the first time. Please take the time to read them before the project starts.
rules.linkText: All rules for the Winterprojekt 2026 at a glance.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.text: You can install the modpack directly via Modrinth or download it as a ZIP file from here.
downloads.modrinthText: Recommended: install via the Modrinth App or a compatible launcher.
downloads.zipText: The complete modpack as a ZIP file for manual import.

mods.title: Mods
mods.text: Click on a mod to go to its Modrinth page.

tutorial.title: Getting started
tutorial.text: I used these two videos to get started with the Create mod. You are also welcome to ask Mineceater.
tutorial.wikiText: All blocks, machines and recipes of the Create mod for reference.

gallery.title: Community Gallery
gallery.description: In the community gallery you will find pictures and clips from the community! Do you have a moment that deserves to be featured here? Send it to PlaywithK on Discord!
